Name: Chiikawa Companions
Author: rainyknights
Description:
Adds Chiikawa characters to follow you around - they don't do much but they're great company 😙

To Install:
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
2. Download this mod
3. Unzip all mods in Stardew Mods folder

You can trade for rings in the raccoon's shop once you unlock it:
[list]
[*]Chiikawa = 1x Miner's Treat[/*]
[*]Hachiware = 1x Cookies[/*]
[*]Usagi = 1x Pancakes[/*]
[*]Momonga = 1x Peach[/*]
[*]Furuhonya = 1x Crab[/*]
[*]Goblin = 1x Bug Steak[/*]
[/list]Or you can download and use CJB Item Spawner to spawn in Chiikawa rings

Credit to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Skalanis]Skalanis[/url] whose [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30889?tab=description]Frieren Companions[/url] I used as a base.
Chiikawa sprites by me.
